title: Settings
saveError: Couldn’t save this setting. Try again.

account.title: Account
account.signOutDescription: Your saved settings and linked folders stay on this computer. You’ll need to sign in again to see your GitHub data.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.languageHint: By default Gdesk uses your computer’s language.
appearance.themeHint: By default Gdesk follows your computer’s light or dark setting.

clone.title: Clone
clone.folderHint: New clones go into this folder. Changing it scans the new folder for repositories.
clone.protocolHint: SSH needs an SSH key added to your GitHub account.
clone.noEditors: No supported editors were found on this computer. Folders open with the system’s default app instead.

homeCards.title: Home cards
homeCards.hint: Choose which sections appear on Home and in what order. The greeting always stays at the top.

folders.title: Linked folders
folders.hint: Unlinking only makes Gdesk forget the link. The folder itself is never deleted.
folders.empty: No folders are linked yet. Clone a repository or link a folder from its page.
folders.unlinkDescription: Gdesk will forget the link to {{path}}. The folder and its files stay on your computer.
folders.rescanSummary: Scan finished. Repositories found: {{found}} · Newly linked: {{added}} · Missing: {{missing}}

relinkErrors.not_git: That folder isn’t the top of a Git repository.
relinkErrors.not_github: That repository has no GitHub remote.
relinkErrors.different_repo: That folder belongs to a different repository.
relinkErrors.unresolved: Couldn’t check the folder’s GitHub remote. You may be offline.

about.title: About
about.disabledHint: This is a development or test build, so Gdesk doesn’t check for updates.
about.unavailableHint: No release source is configured for this build, so updates can’t be checked.
about.notifyHint: This build can’t update itself. Download the new version from the release page.
